title: Tokyo Game Show 2024 Giveaway
body:
See full terms and conditions in the Master Sweepstakes Rules here: https://support.discord.com/hc/en-us/articles/16000885744791-Master-Sweepstakes-Rules

By entering, you agree to these Master Sweepstakes Terms.

  1. Eligibility Requirements: You must be a legal resident of Japan and at least eighteen (18) years of age or older as of the date of entry.
  2. Entry Time Frame: October 1, 2024 6:00PM PST - October 8, 2024 6:00PM PST
  3. How to Enter: Like the official @discord_jp Giveaway post on Twitter/X and reply with the first video game that you ever played.
  4. Prizes: Three (3) winners ($300 USD Total Prize Value):
    • Three (3) Prize Winners will receive ($100.00 USD Total Value):
      • One (1) Kaiju Wumpus Plushie ($50.00 USD Value)
      • One (1) Tokyo Special Edition Figurines ($50.00 USD Value)
  5. Winner Notification Date: October 17, 2024

Notification Method: Winners will be notified via DM through the account they used to enter the Giveaway and have one week to respond in order to claim their prize.
